comment: Letta Web production bundle budget, checked by scripts/ci/web-bundle-budget.py in the web-wasm job (letta-mobile-hv54v).
Ceilings are gzip bytes (level 9) of what a visitor downloads: the page's wasm and script before the first frame, the Iroh transport on the first connect, the mascot runtime and file when it shows.

Each ceiling sits about 3% above the size measured when it was set (Iroh 5%, since local and CI Rust toolchains differ by about 1%). Ceilings only come down: lower one when a change shrinks its group; never raise one to make a build pass.

kotlin-app-and-skiko-wasm.notes: Owner-approved increase by Emmanuel on 2026-10-25 from 7,980,000 to 8,000,000 for native document viewers and durable canvas handoff (PR #2226). Optimized CI gzip measurements using the same budget checker: a5c76949e 7,982,571 bytes; registry simplification at 4d77e2c24 7,982,512 bytes (one run each, 59-byte reduction); session-replacement fix at fb3056b86 and test-only a91c48327 both 7,982,879 bytes (runs 40179503678 and 40182177974). New headroom is 17,121 bytes, not 3%. No correctness gate relaxed. Previous increase 7,900,000 to 7,980,000 was owner-approved on 2026-10-23 for browser pairing PR #2188.
